name: Forklift Operator
description: This course trains delegates to operate a counterbalance forklift safely and productively in a working environment. It covers pre-shift inspections, load handling, stacking and de-stacking, refuelling or battery charging, and workplace safety rules. The training is aligned with unit standards where applicable, and successful delegates receive a certificate issued by RSTL Centre. It suits new operators and experienced drivers who need formal proof of competence. Training takes place on-site at your premises or at our centres in Midrand, Durban and Mthatha.
outcomes: Carry out pre-operational checks and identify faults or damage before use
Handle, stack and de-stack loads safely and within the forklift's rated capacity
Apply correct refuelling, battery charging and parking procedures
Work safely around pedestrians, vehicles and racking in a warehouse or yard
Receive a accredited certificate on successful completion
audience: Warehouse and factory workers who operate or will operate a forklift
New operators with no experience who want formal training
Experienced drivers who need a certificate for employment or compliance
Supervisors and team leaders who manage forklift operations

faqs.q: How much does forklift training cost?
faqs.a: The forklift course costs R1,500 per learner. It runs daily at our Midrand, Durban and Mthatha centres, and we also train on site at client warehouses across South Africa. Group bookings are negotiable, so ask for a rate if you are sending more than one operator. Email info@rehtraining.co.za or call 010 746 6954 to book.

faqs.q: How long does the forklift course take?
faqs.a: Duration is quoted per booking, because it depends on the course format and the group size. A quote from RSTL Centre will state the full duration for your specific booking. Classes run daily, so there is no waiting period to start. Email us at info@rehtraining.co.za or call 010 746 6954 to arrange your dates.

faqs.q: Do I need experience before I can do forklift training?
faqs.a: No, this course is open to new operators. It covers the basics from pre-shift inspections to load handling, so you can start without prior experience. Delegates should be physically able to operate the machine and follow safety instructions. If you already drive a forklift, the course also works as formal certification for your current skill level.

Email us at info@rehtraining.co.za or call 010 746 6954, and we will arrange a visit and a quote.
